COURSE OBJECTIVES
Install, configure and secure server operating systems.
Develop communication and teamwork skills
essential for system administrators.
Communicate effectively in a variety of
professional contexts.

Category Points

Homework and Discussion 30 %

Group Project and presentation 10%

Quizzes 17.5%

Test 17.5%

Total 100%

GRADING SCALE

90 – 100 % A
